== Summary ==
Before/after published-layout comparison for [[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata 3)]]. Left: existing Players Committee full face [[:File:V7-L-diceibegon.gif]], with only 34px of exterior top padding cropped. Right: the official partial slip from [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf]], page 2, image xref 12, with its original PDF mask. Source faces are not repainted or completed. The blank surrounding area belongs to this comparison canvas. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original images published by the Players Committee.
